newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan overnight unchanged at 3.00-4.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Jordan overnight unchanged at 3.00-4.00 pct.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Jordanian dinar were little changed on Wednesday at between 3.00 percent and 4.00 percent from 3.25 percent to 4.00 percent on Tuesday.
Bankers said despite the slight widening in rates, Wednesday's market was a little tighter than Tuesday, when some banks briefly offered rates as low as 2.5 percent.
They said they expected the rates to ease again on Thursday, as some dealers were unwilling to enter the overnight market over the Friday weekend.
